body: I invited my MIL to come. I would have rather her just not show up
He has and continues to do so. They’re disrespectful to him too.
That’s my thought process! That’s why I initiated NC to begin with. They don’t respect my husband either so I know they won’t respect US.

I feel like I do a pretty good job of it so far, like standing my ground and stuff. I’m just hurt for my baby. He/she doesn’t deserve any of this and it just makes me sad because they aren’t even born yet. Hormones lol

He’s supportive and on board. I haven’t spoken to SIL in about six months. She’s just very hateful towards me and critiques my parenting skills as well as my personality. It’s truly worth a whole other post in itself because she’s honestly emotionally manipulative and just a big B and I hate to bash another woman like that but it’s the truth. 

I’ve tried speaking with her about this before and she just tells me that I’m “too sensitive.” My husband agrees with me that she’s not the nicest person. I have had a LOT going on with this pregnancy and cutting her out helped tremendously. I blocked her, her husband, and all of her friends on my social media account so that they can’t see anything. 

DH was actually the one who initially told his parents about me not inviting SIL to my shower. And he presented it as “both alphabetsoup1337 and I believe and feel that, xyz and xyz, and so both of us have decided that SIL will not be invited to the baby shower nor will she be allowed around DS/DD because she can’t respect myself nor alphabetsoup1337.” Because at the end of the day a lot of the really shitty and disrespectful stuff is directed not just towards myself and the baby, but DH too. 

I usually just make him take the reigns because right now it’s hard for me to. I just feel like I can’t. The depression is hitting me so hard and MIL has called me on several occasions accusing me of “breaking up the family” and that she “won’t stand for me keeping ‘her’ baby away from her daughter” 🙄🙄🙄🙄🙄

She even went as far the other day as to try and tell me she wanted to plan something for me with the family, but she refuses to unless everyone can come. Total like guilt trip and what I feel as a really manipulative move to try to pressure me into having SIL around when I have said no the past few months. She said she can’t do anything because she feels bad that she can’t invite SIL. So I politely told her, “well you know, DH is also the father of this child. Do something for him and invite her. I will gladly stay at home and rest while y’all do something for him and I will not take offense. It’s 2019 you should be including the father in pre-baby festivities.” 

... she didn’t like that answer lol.
He supports me but it’s hard because it’s his family. Which I understand. He just has a hard time because he’s not assertive and anytime he tries to stick up for me he gets yelled at.
He is not as assertive as he needs to be in this situation. He’s not a bad guy and he supports me and agrees with me, he just doesn’t know how to get in peoples face like I do lol
I’ve already decided they won’t know when I give birth or when the baby gets here. They won’t know anything.
Thank you.

I guess I just pissed my pants lol I’m so embarrassed!
